description.en:
Field Plot Registry is used for administration of EUs area-based agricultural subsidies. It includes the outer borders of basic plots. Basic plot is a homogeneous area, cultivated by same farmer.

Coordinate Reference System: YKJ / Finland Uniform Coordinate System (EPSG:2393)

creator: Agency for Rural Affairs in Finland
